title: Former stray cat plays with cat teaser stick for the first time
description:
This little orange fuzzball, a former stray with sunshine in his fur, got the biggest surprise!

He'd never seen a cat teaser before, and his eyes went wide as saucers when a feathery thing started dancing in the air.

With a tiny leap and a surprised meow, he was off!

He stalked the feathery critter with the intensity of a jungle hunter, then pounced with a wiggle of his whole tiny body.

It was love at first pounce.

You could practically hear him purring, This is the best game ever!
Location: Guangzhou, China
